children: Unicycive Therapeutics reported a securities class action filed alleging misleading statements about its oxylanthanum carbonate NDA; the company says it will defend the suit.
Class action filed Sept. 3, 2026 in N.D. California against Unicycive Therapeutics and certain officers.
Lawsuit alleges violations of federal securities laws related to public statements on the oxylanthanum carbonate NDA.
Drug candidate targets hyperphosphatemia in dialysis patients; allegations concern related public disclosures.
Company believes the claims are meritless and intends to vigorously defend the lawsuit.
